name: The Long Ballad
description: Li Chang Ge's family was murdered by Li Shi Min, the Emperor of Tang, during the Xuanwu Gate Incident. She heads to Shuo Province under the guise of a man with hopes of raising an army to kill Li Shi Min to avenge her family's death. However, as a captain of the army of Shuo Province in Zhangzhou, she loses a siege by the Eastern Turkic Khaganate General Ashina Sun, who takes her to serve him as a personal military strategist.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Li Changge survives the palace massacre that kills her father and brothers, escapes into hiding, and vows to avenge her family as she abandons her life as a princess.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Changge evades pursuit, sheds the last traces of her old life, and hardens her resolve to grow strong enough to avenge her family.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Changge is betrayed in Youzhou, forced to flee again, and realises she can rely only on herself.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Changge is taken by Ashile Sun, forced to travel under his watch, and waits for the moment to break free.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Changge studies the Ashile camp from inside her captivity, quietly turning prisonerhood into advantage.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Changge travels with the Ashile army, quietly observing their tactics while waiting for the right moment to escape.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Changge’s escape fails, and Ashile Sun recaptures her—more intrigued by her resolve than angered.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Changge enters the Ashile Khan’s court, reads the shifting politics around her, and uses her wits to stay alive under growing scrutiny.
